summary: Cognition announced SWE-2 Flash on 2026-11-04. The model is available in Devin Desktop and CLI at one-fifth the price and 3x the speed of SWE-2, and its use is free through 11/30. Cognition is not sharing the weights publicly yet. The launch post states no usage limits and does not say which Devin plans qualify; Devin's pricing page lists limited model availability on the Free plan and full model availability on Pro.
claim_steps: Sign in to Devin Desktop or the Devin CLI
Use the SWE-2 Flash model before 2026-11-30

social_proof.title: Introducing SWE-2 Flash | Cognition
social_proof.text: Free through 11/30. Try it today in Devin Desktop and CLI. It is available today in Devin Desktop and CLI, at one-fifth the price and 3x the speed of its much larger sibling, SWE-2.

social_proof.title: Devin Plans and Pricing
social_proof.text: The Free plan includes a light quota to code with agents, limited model availability, unlimited inline edits, and unlimited Tab completions.

social_proof.title: Cognition launches SWE-2 Flash with a free offer through November 30
social_proof.text: Cognition announced SWE-2 Flash on November 4, 2026, making a new coding model available in Devin Desktop and CLI. The company advertises free use through November 30. The offer concerns model use, not a free Devin subscription; eligibility and service limits are unspecified.
